formula.ip: Decimal innings = outs / 3; notation: whole innings + 0.0 / 0.1 / 0.2

pa.definition: The number of times a player has taken his turn at bat

gp.definition: Games in which a player has appeared

g.definition: Games in which the pitcher threw at least one pitch

ab.definition: Trips to the plate that do not result in a walk, hit by pitch, sacrifice, or reach on interference

oneB.definition: A hit on which the batter reaches first base safely

r.definition: When a baserunner safely reaches home plate and scores

h.definition: When a batter reaches base safely on a fair batted ball, without the benefit of an error or a fielder's choice

twoB.definition: A hit on which the batter reaches second base safely

threeB.definition: A hit on which the batter reaches third base safely

hr.definition: When a batter reaches on a hit, touches all bases, and scores a run without a putout recorded or the benefit of error

iphr.definition: A batter scores by circling the bases on a batted ball that stays in play

pitchHr.definition: Home runs allowed by a pitcher

pitchInsideParkHr.definition: Inside-the-park home runs credited against the pitcher

rbi.definition: Runs scored as a direct result of the batter's plate appearance (for example, on a hit, walk, sacrifice fly, or hit-by-pitch when the bases are loaded)

bb.definition: Awarded first base after four balls, including intentional walks

ibb.definition: The number of times a batter was intentionally walked

hbp.definition: When a batter is struck by a pitched ball which he is not attempting to hit and is awarded first base

hb.definition: When a batter is struck by a pitched ball which he is not attempting to hit

so.definition: When the batter is retired on three strikes

pitchSo.definition: When a pitcher throws any combination of three swinging or looking strikes to a hitter

w.definition: Credited to the pitcher whose team takes the lead while he is the pitcher of record and keeps it

l.definition: Credited to the pitcher when his team gives up a lead it never regains

gs.definition: Games started by the pitcher (the first pitcher for his team)

cg.definition: When a pitcher starts and finishes the entire game without relief

pg.definition: When a pitcher throws a complete game and allows no runs

sho.definition: When a pitcher throws a complete game and allows no runs

sv.definition: Awarded to a relief pitcher who preserves a win under save-rule conditions

svo.definition: Appearances in which a pitcher enters with a chance to earn a save

ip.definition: Number of putouts recorded while pitching divided by three; .1 means 1/3 inning and .2 means 2/3

tbf.definition: Total number of batters faced by a pitcher

bf.definition: Total number of batters faced by a pitcher

pitchBf.definition: Total number of batters faced by a pitcher

pIp.definition: Average number of pitches thrown per inning

qs.definition: Credited to a starting pitcher who pitches at least six innings and allows three earned runs or fewer

gf.definition: Credited to a pitcher who is the last pitcher for his team in a game and was not the starter

er.definition: Earned runs allowed by a pitcher

era.definition: The average number of earned runs a pitcher allows per 9 innings

whip.fullName: Walks and Hits Per Inning Pitched
whip.definition: The ratio of walks plus hits to innings pitched

avgAgainst.definition: The rate of hits per at bat against a pitcher

sbAllowed.definition: Total stolen bases while a pitcher is on the mound

csAllowed.definition: Total runners caught stealing while a pitcher is on the mound

pk.definition: When a pitcher throws to a fielder resulting in a putout of a baserunner leading off base

sh.definition: When a batter advances one or more runners at least one base with a bunt

sac.definition: When a batter advances one or more runners at least one base with a bunt

sf.definition: When a batter hits a caught fly ball that allows a runner to score

gdp.definition: When a player hits a ground ball that results in more than one out

gidp.definition: When a player hits a ground ball that results in more than one out

xbh.definition: Total hits that were not singles

tb.definition: The total number of bases gained by a batter through his hits

babip.fullName: Batting Average on Balls in Play
babip.definition: Batting average on balls hit into the field of play, excluding outcomes like home runs and strikeouts

iso.definition: A hitter power metric measuring extra bases per at bat

bbPct.definition: The rate at which a batter walks in plate appearances

kPct.definition: The rate at which a batter strikes out in plate appearances

fip.definition: An ERA-like metric based on outcomes mostly controlled by pitchers: HR, BB, HBP, and SO

eraPlus.definition: ERA normalized to league and park context where 100 is league average

inn.definition: Total innings played on defense at a given position

po.definition: A fielder is credited with a putout when he records an out directly

a.definition: Credited to a fielder who throws or deflects a ball leading to a putout

e.definition: Charged when a fielder misplays a ball, allowing a runner or batter to advance

dp.definition: A defensive play resulting in two offensive players being put out

pb.definition: Charged to the catcher when a legally pitched ball should have been handled with ordinary effort but gets away and allows advancement

catcherCs.definition: Runners thrown out by the catcher while attempting to steal

tcPct.definition: Rate at which a fielder records outs without an error.

sb.definition: A runner advances a base unaided by a hit, error, or other advancing event

cs.definition: A runner is put out while attempting to steal a base

avg.definition: The rate of hits per at bat

obp.definition: The rate at which a batter reaches base in plate appearances

slg.definition: The rate of total bases per at bat

ops.definition: The sum of on-base percentage and slugging percentage

opsPlus.definition: OPS normalized to league and park context where 100 is league average

bipPct.definition: Share of plate appearances that end with a ball in play
